name: Weavr
subtitle: Weavr for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV
description: Unsigned Weavr builds for iOS and tvOS. Add this source to Feather (or any AltStore-compatible signer) to install and update Weavr.

apps.name: Weavr iOS
apps.subtitle: 18 Nov 16:50 GMT · Multi-source IPTV with automatic failover
apps.localizedDescription: Weavr merges your M3U and Xtream sources into one library, removes duplicate channels and films across providers, and fails over to another source when a stream stalls. Includes a TV guide, films and series, continue watching, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, and WeavrLink, a remote for your Weavr TVs.

versions.localizedDescription: Build fix: the collection picker's type renamed (SiloPick was taken by the Silo profile picker); VLC's sound mix set by its value
Player: VLC for everything by default (every format, Picture in Picture, background audio), Silo included through the relay; Apple's player only when chosen in Settings › Playback › Player
Build fix: published year worked out in steps
Sport: Nations Championship, MotoGP, Super League, RFL Championship and NRL from TheSportsDB (as on the TV: next and last fifteen per league, teams to follow); 'Every competition' removed

Sport cards: the teams' own colours across the card (home one end, away the other), the sport's colour where there are no teams, and a stripe of the sport's colour down the side — Home and the Sport page alike

Saved library kept: the films-and-series index was being deleted with old pieces after every save (so every launch fetched every source again); a missing piece keeps the rest; settings subpages on the newer inline title call so the tabs' inline-large doesn't carry over
Build fix: OPDS author read before it's set
iOS build fix: the book sheet's file wasn't to be both unwrapped and cleared under one name (compiler crash)

Big libraries: Silo titles made page by page (no raw JSON held for the whole list); films and series saved and read in stamped pieces, index last, at utility priority; Home's shelves built behind the splash

Player: languages picked as on the TV — audio asked for as VLC opens, tracks looked at again as they turn up, foreign-only grace for late forced tracks, OpenSubtitles fetched automatically with a key (foreign parts only when asked), language codes in any form
Fix build: declare the clip reader's private methods
Books: refreshing or adding one source looks at that source's books only, never every server

Faster Xtream imports, timed in the log

- A panel's lists are read in one pass: rows stay as decoded and a field
  is converted only when used, rather than first building a whole second
  copy of a 100,000-row list.
- A source's channels (then its guide) and its films and series load at
  the same time, each downloading while the other is read and merged; the
  same for due refreshes.
- Settings › Log times each step: each list's size, download and reading,
  each merge, and the whole refresh — so the slow part can be seen.
Qualities fill in faster: each source's copies read side by side with the others', 7 s a header at most
Fix build: no lazy chain over non-escaping closures in Home's newest row

Books: read EPUB, PDF and CBZ in the app

- EPUB: unpacked once (ZIPFoundation), read from its package's spine a
  chapter at a time in a web view coloured to the app's theme, with the
  contents list, previous/next, text size, and your place kept (chapter
  and how far down). Links between chapters move the place; links out
  open in Safari.
- PDF: PDFKit, your page kept.
- CBZ: its pictures a page at a time, swipe and pinch to zoom.
- Other kinds (MOBI, AZW…) still offer Open in….
